en-US.title: Studento
en-US.subtitle: Class countdown and bell clock
en-US.description:
Studento is a clock for school. It counts down to the end of every period, in seconds, so you always know how long is left.

SET IT UP IN A MINUTE
Pick your school and its bell schedule from the shared list, or add your school and publish its schedule for everyone there. Then take a photo of your class schedule and the reader fills in your classes and rooms (you check every row before it saves), or type them in.

ALWAYS AT A GLANCE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show the time left in the period, then a live clock with seconds after school
• A Lock Screen countdown and Dynamic Island timer during class
• Bell alerts a few minutes into class and five minutes before the bell

MAKE IT YOURS
• More than 100 themes: split-flap boards, casino reels, gold Art Deco, LED signs, nixie tubes and more
• Three layouts, a focus timer, this week, notes, grades and homework
• Lock mode keeps the clock on screen with every setting out of reach until you hold the red dot

WORKS OFFLINE
The clock, alerts, widgets and themes need no internet. An optional account (just a username and password) saves your schedule and settings across devices and turns on the schedule reader. You can delete it in the app at any time.
en-US.promoText: Count down every class. Runs entirely on your phone.

review.phone: (kept out of the public repo: see store.config.local.json + scripts/store-config-merge.mjs)
review.notes: No account is needed. First launch runs a short setup wizard; every step has Skip: tap Get started, Skip (school), Skip for now (classes), Not now (alerts), Skip (theme), Skip for now (account), Open the clock. Or pick "Great Neck North High School" on the school step to see a real bell schedule. Accounts (optional, username + password only) can be created on the last wizard step or in Settings > Account; deletion is in Settings > Account. The schedule reader (Settings > Schedule > My classes > Scan) needs an account and sends the photo to our server once; it is not stored. User-generated content: shared schools and bell schedules have a Report action (reason + note) that goes to the admin, who can remove them (Settings > Admin on the owner account). Settings > More > "Pretend it's Period 3" shows the countdown, widgets and Live Activity at any time of day. Widgets: long-press the Home Screen, add "Studento". Support: studentoclockapp@gmail.com.
